paite: Saul inkuante leh David inkuante sawtpi akidou ua; David in hatlam amanoh a, Saul inkuante'n hat louh lam amanoh uhi.
heading: David Tapate
english: Now there was a long war between Saul’s house and David’s house. David grew stronger and stronger, but Saul’s house grew weaker and weaker.

paite: David in Hebron ah tapate anei a, ata masapen, Amnon, Jezreel mi Ahinoam lak a ahi.
english: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

paite: Azom Kileab, Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail lak a ahi. Athumna Absalom, Geshur kumpipa Talmai tanu Maakah tapa ahi.
english: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

paite: Alina Adonijah, Haggith tapa ahi a; angana Shephatiah, Abital tapa.
english: and the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

paite: Agukna Ithream, David zi Eglah lak a ahi. Hiai teng David tapa Hebron a piangte ahi uh.
english: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Saul inkuante leh David inkuante akidou sung un Saul inkuante a ding in Abner akihatsak semsem hi.
heading: David Lam Ah Abner Ahong Pang
english: While there was war between Saul’s house and David’s house, Abner made himself strong in Saul’s house.

paite: Saul in mei anei a, amin Rizpah ahi. Amah Aiah tanu ahi. Ishboshet in Abner kiang ah, "Bangziak a ka pa mei kithuahpih na hia?" achi hi.
english: Now Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah; and Ishbosheth said to Abner, “Why have you gone in to my father’s concubine?”

paite: Ishboshet thugen in Abner ahehsak mahmah hi. Judahte ui lutang leltak ka hi a hia? Tuni tan in na pa Saul inkuante leh a-unaute leh alawmte tung ah zahngaihna ka hihlang a, David khut ah ka hon pe kei hi. Hinapi a nang hiai numei tung a khial a na hon ngoh mawk!
english: Then Abner was very angry about Ishbosheth’s words, and said, “Am I a dog’s head that belongs to Judah? Today I show kindness to your father Saul’s house, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David; and yet you charge me today with a fault concerning this woman!

paite: Pathian in Abner alohloh in loh henla, huai sang a sezaw in leng. David kiang a TOUPA akichiam bang a, huchibang ngei atung a ka hih keileh.
english: God do so to Abner, and more also, if, as Yahweh has sworn to David, I don’t do even so to him:

paite: Saul inkuante lak a pan agam laksak ding, Israel leh Judahte tung a Dan a pan a Beer-sheba tan a David laltutphah tunding ding.
english: to transfer the kingdom from Saul’s house, and to set up David’s throne over Israel and over Judah, from Dan even to Beersheba.”

paite: Huchi in ama'n Abner alau mahmah ziak in dawn himhim leng adawng thei kei hi.
english: He could not answer Abner another word, because he was afraid of him.

paite: Abner in amah sik in David kiang ah mi asawl a, "Hiai gam kua a ahia? Ka kiang ah thu khung in. Huchi in ngai in, Israel mi tengteng na lam a pang ding in ka khut nang lam ah apang ding," chi in ava gensak hi.
english: Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, “Whose is the land?” and saying, “Make your alliance with me, and behold, my hand will be with you to bring all Israel around to you.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hi hen. Na kiang ah thu ka khung ding. Himahleh na tung ah thil khat ka hon phut hi. Huai tuh hiai ahi. Hong mu ding a na hong pai chiang in Saul tanu Mikal na hon pi phot keileh ka mel na mu thei kei ding," achi hi.
english: David said, “Good. I will make a treaty with you, but one thing I require of you. That is, you will not see my face unless you first bring Michal, Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.”

paite: David in Saul tapa Ishboshet kiang ah, "Philistia mite zekvun zakhat a ka leisa, ka zi Mikal hon pia in," chi ding in mi asawl hi.
english: David sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, saying, “Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I was given to marry for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.”

paite: Ishboshet in mi asawl a, apasal Laish tapa Paltiel mahmah a pan apita hi.
english: Ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband, Paltiel the son of Laish.

paite: Apasal in kap kawm in Bahurim tan anung azui zel hi. Abner in akiang ah, "Pai in, kik nawn in," achi hi. Huchi in akik nawnta hi.
english: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then Abner said to him, “Go! Return!” and he returned.

paite: Abner in Israel upate ahoupih a, "Tuma siah David na kumpipa ding un na zong uh.
english: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, “In times past, you sought for David to be king over you.

paite: Tu in na kumpipa un bawl un. TOUPA'N David tungtang thu ah, ka sikha David khut in ka mi Israelte Philistia mite khut a pan leh amelma teng khut a pan ka hunkhe ding ana chi," achi hi.
english: Now then do it! For Yahweh has spoken of David, saying, ‘By the hand of my servant David, I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.’”

paite: Abner in Benjamin mite bil a zak in agen hi. Israel mite leh Benjamin inkuan tengteng in hoih asak bangbang un Hebron a David bil a zak dia gen ding in Abner ahoh hi.
english: Abner also spoke in the ears of Benjamin; and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Israel and to the whole house of Benjamin.

paite: Abner leh amite sawmnih Hebron a David kiang ah apai uhi. David in Abner leh akiang a mi sawmnihte a ding in ankuang alui hi.
english: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. David made Abner and the men who were with him a feast.

paite: Abner in David kiang ah, "Ka thou ding a, na kiang a thu akhuntheihna ding un leh na deihthusam bangtak a vai na hawmtheihna ding in Israel mi tengteng ka toupa kiang a kaikhawm ding in ka kuan ding,” achi hi. David in Abner asawlkhia a, lungmuangtak in akuanta hi.
english: Abner said to David, “I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires.” David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

paite: Ngai in, David mite leh Joab galdou zou ahong tung ua, gallak tampi ahon pua uh. Himahleh Abner bel Hebron a David kiang ah ana om nawn kei hi. Ana paikiksak khinta a, amah leng lungmuangtak in ana paita hi.
heading: Abner Thah In A-om
english: Behold, David’s servants and Joab came from a raid and brought in a great plunder with them; but Abner was not with David in Hebron, for he had sent him away, and he had gone in peace.

paite: Joab leh akiang a mipi tengteng ahong tun un, Ner tapa Abner kumpipa kiang ah ahoh hi. Ama'n ana paisak nawn khin a, "Lungmuangtak in apai nawnta," chi in Joab ahilh uhi.
english: When Joab and all the army who was with him had come, they told Joab, “Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he has gone in peace.”

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah Joab ahoh a, "Na thilhih bangchidan ahia oi? Ngai in, Abner na kiang ah ahong a, bangziak a paimangsak a, apaimang vengveng mawk?
english: Then Joab came to the king and said, “What have you done? Behold, Abner came to you. Why is it that you have sent him away, and he is already gone?

paite: Ner tapa Abner na thei a, nang hong khem ding a na pawt lam leh na lut lam leh na thilhih peuhmah theih tum a hong pai ahi," achi hi.
english: You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.”

paite: David kiang a pan Joab ahong pawtkhiak in Abner delh ding in mi asawl hi. Sirah a tuileh a pan ava pikik uh. Himahleh David in athei kei hi.
english: When Joab had come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah; but David didn’t know it.

paite: Hebron a Abner ahong tun in Joab in sim houpih ding in kulh kongpi ah apituam hi. A-unaupa Asahel sisan pawt thukna ding in anakguh ngana nuaitak ah adawt a, huchi in asita hi.
english: When Abner had returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside into the middle of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died for the blood of Asahel his brother.

paite: Anung a David in azak in, "Ner tapa Abner sisan thu ah kei mahleh ka gam TOUPA mitmuh in tangtawn in ka siang uh.
english: Afterward, when David heard it, he said, “I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahweh forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner.

paite: Joab lutung ah kia henla; apa inkote tengteng tung ah toh. Joab inkote lak ah meima sia vei hiam, phak natna nei hiam, chiangkhun ngai a pai hiam, namsau a si hiam, kial thuak hiam kitatlak lou in hong om hen," achi hi.
english: Let it fall on the head of Joab and on all his father’s house. Let there not fail from the house of Joab one who has a discharge, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.”

paite: Huchi in a-unaupa uh Asahel Gibeon a kidouna a athah ziak in Joab leh a-unau Abishai in Abner athat uhi.
english: So Joab and Abishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

paite: David in Joab leh akiang a mi om tengteng kiang ah, "Na puante uh botkek unla, sai-ip puan silh unla, Abner suun in ama ah pai un," achi hi. David in leng siluang azui hi.
heading: Abner Vui In A-om
english: David said to Joab and to all the people who were with him, “Tear your clothes, and clothe yourselves with sackcloth, and mourn in front of Abner.” King David followed the bier.

paite: Hebron ah Abner avui ua, kumpipa'n a-aw suakkhesak in Abner han ah akap a, mipi tengteng leng akap uhi.
english: They buried Abner in Hebron; and the king lifted up his voice and wept at Abner’s grave; and all the people wept.

paite: Kumpipa'n Abner akah a: "Abner, mihai sih in asi dia hia?
english: The king lamented for Abner, and said, “Should Abner die as a fool dies?

paite: Na khut hen ahi kei a, na khete leng sikkol butsak ahi sam kei. Migiloute ma a mi apuk bang a na puk maizen? achi hi." Mi tengteng in akah nawn uhi.
english: Your hands weren’t bound, and your feet weren’t put into fetters. As a man falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell.” All the people wept again over him.

paite: Huchi in sun ahih lai in mi tengteng David an nesak ding in ahong pai uh. Himahleh David in, "Nitum ma a an nek hiam, thil dang hiam leng ka nekleh Pathian in alohloh hon loh hen; huai sang a sezaw in leng," chi in akichiam hi.
english: All the people came to urge David to eat bread while it was yet day; but David swore, saying, “God do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread or anything else, until the sun goes down.”

paite: Mi tengteng in huai atheih un akipak mahmah uh. Kumpipa thilhih peuhmah in mite akipaksak hi.
english: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them, as whatever the king did pleased all the people.

paite: Mi tengteng leh Israel mi tengteng in huai ni in Ner tapa Abner thah ahih kumpipa thu ahi kei chih athei uhi.
english: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.

paite: Kumpipa'n mite kiang ah, "Tuni in Israel milian, mithupitak asi, chih thei lou na hi uh maw?
english: The king said to his servants, “Don’t you know that a prince and a great man has fallen today in Israel?

paite: Kumpipa dia thaunilh himah leng, tuni in ka hat kei hi. Hiai Zeruiah tapate kei a ding in athuakhak lua uh. TOUPA'N thil hoih lou hihmi agitlouh dungzui zel in thuk hen," achi hi.
english: I am weak today, though anointed king. These men, the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May Yahweh reward the evildoer according to his wickedness.”
